name: Should I keep a bathtub or convert to a large walk-in shower in my primary bath?

mainEntity.name: Should I keep a bathtub or convert to a large walk-in shower in my primary bath?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tub-to-shower conversion replaces an oversized or underused garden bathtub with a spacious walk-in shower enclosure. Deciding between them depends on daily routine, mobility, and household needs. Walk-in showers improve accessibility, eliminate high step-over thresholds, and make everyday routines faster. Retaining a separate soaking tub is beneficial if household members regularly bathe or prefer soaking. Homeowners who remove garden tubs often gain valuable floor space to expand double-sink vanities, add built-in linen storage, or create a larger shower footprint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Converting an unused tub to a walk-in shower improves daily accessibility and frees floor space, while keeping a tub suits homeowners who enjoy soaking or have bathing needs.
